description: IaC Phase 4 (groupscout-site-6ah.5): weekly, grouped update PRs. Nothing automerges; CI must pass before a PR can merge.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain cool-off: wait a week before proposing new Go modules and Actions.
Actions and runner labels. Images used in workflows follow the image rules below.
One weekly PR for base and service images. A package used in several files (pgvector in Compose and the CI service) always updates in one PR.
These migrate their data forward and cannot be downgraded: one PR each.
prBodyNotes: This image migrates its data volume forward and cannot be rolled back by reverting the tag. Read the release notes and take a backup before deploying.
